name: regai
description: Your in-house Vietnamese legal consultant in Claude Code. Answers are grounded in a curated, always-current corpus of Vietnamese law — with in-force status and related documents enforced on every answer, and every claim cited — instead of a general model's outdated, unsourced training data. Ships with workflows and templates for drafting, review, memos and compliance, and learns your industry and house style over time.

api_token.title: regai API token (optional)
api_token.description: Optional. Leave blank to use regai anonymously — the tools work without a token. Provide your personal token (a UUID the maintainer gives you) for per-user attribution: run /regai-setup and Claude will fill it in, or set it via /plugin → Configure options.
